name: WHCW World Championship
epitaph: Held five separate times by Adonis Mercury before a promotion-wide contract dispute left him stripped of it, with no successor named in this record.

name: WHCW North American Championship
epitaph: Vacated by a former champion under circumstances not attested in this record before Chris Tyler claimed it by presidential decree during an unsanctioned construction-site brawl.

name: WHCW North American Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Changed hands when the returning Ultranationalists, disguised as an unfamiliar team, defeated the Sociopaths after a backstage beatdown left the champions battered before the bell.

name: WHCW Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: Won by Speed Racer from a previous champion, Dragon, and defended successfully against a rare heavyweight challenger.

name: WHCW Extreme Championship
epitaph: Left vacant before being won in a five-man steel cage elimination match that put two competitors in the hospital.
